Hi Nina,

It was great to meet you at the Midwest Retail Ops Summit. As promised, here is a little more about Northstar.

Northstar makes FlowOS for shift scheduling, Connect for team messaging and Insight for dashboards. Partners who resell our products earn a 20 percent margin on first-year subscriptions.

If this sounds interesting, let me know and we can find a time to talk.

[Your name]

accurate.reason: The summit, Nina's name and the 20 percent margin all match the notes and partner facts.

why.reason: Mentions the summit but not the real fit: clients asking for scheduling their current tool can't do on a phone.

ask.reason: Asks to talk, but leaves Nina to suggest a time and a format.

tone.reason: Friendly and plain, if a little general.

runs.output:
Hi Ben,

Thank you for getting back to us on LinkedIn. I wanted to share a bit more about Northstar Systems and why we think a partnership could make sense.

Northstar makes three products. FlowOS handles shift scheduling for hourly teams and has an open scheduling API. Connect is our team messaging product, and it has had an open messaging API since June 2026. Insight turns scheduling data into dashboards, and it can also be resold on its own. Our resellers earn a 20 percent margin on first-year subscriptions.

We work with many kinds of partners, from resellers to software companies that build integrations, and we would love to explore what working together could look like for Tidewater Payroll and your customers. I am also happy to include Grace Kim from your sales team.

Please let me know if you would be open to a conversation in the coming weeks.

Best regards,
[Your name]

accurate.reason: Every product fact is right, and both contacts are named correctly.

why.reason: Lists all three products but never names the real fit: approved FlowOS shifts flowing into Tidewater's payroll.

ask.reason: Asks for a conversation in the coming weeks, with no length and no day.

tone.reason: Polite, but reads like a brochure rather than a note to Ben.

Would you be open to a call to talk about how we could work together?

why.reason: Picks up the texting problem, but skips his question about clinic tablets.

ask.reason: Asks for a call with no length, no day and no clear purpose.

tone.reason: Short and friendly, and it sounds like the booth chat really happened.

tone.reason: Warm and plain for a cold message.

Good news: Connect has had an open messaging API since June 2026. There is real synergy between Summit Field Software and Northstar, and I think field service teams would get a lot out of it.

tone.reason: "Real synergy" reads like a sales template.
